scope: In packages/runtime/src/pi/tools.ts, `toolArgs(config, "root")` returns `--tools +codemode` with `--exclude-tools write,edit`. Because `+codemode` keeps Pi's default selection, which includes every enabled extension's tools, the root currently also holds the computer-use tools (`computer_use_*`, with `pi.features.computerUse` on) and the web tools of the web choice (`webChoice(profile, features.web).tools`, e.g. pi-web-kit's tools or Kimi's moonshot_search and moonshot_fetch). The Claude root has neither (the holyagent agent excludes WebFetch and WebSearch, and its rules send research to the Librarian roles and visual inspection to the visual specialists), and docs/pi/extensions.md says only the visual specialists get computer use.

Change the root's exclusions to add, while each is enabled, the computer-use tools (COMPUTER_USE_TOOLS) and the web choice's tools (none when the web choice is off). Keep `write,edit` excluded and keep `+codemode`, todo, ask_user_question, the process tools and the subagent tools on the root. Use the profile argument for the web choice as the specialists do.
Add tests in packages/runtime/tests/pi/tools.test.ts that fail without the change: root exclusions with computerUse on and off, with web pi-web-kit, provider (Kimi profile) and off.

Leave Reviewer.code's bash as it is: it mirrors packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts:265, where the Claude Reviewer.code gets Bash for git diff and test runs.
